slides.title: Money can't buy happiness. But if you run a locksmith business, it can buy:

slides.label: Luxury #1
slides.title: Knowing when your license renews without checking the glovebox.
slides.body: Where states require one, it has a date. That date doesn't text you.

slides.label: Luxury #2
slides.title: A current COI ready before the property manager asks twice.
slides.body: Not the one from last year. The one that says 2026.

slides.label: Luxury #3
slides.title: One list with every renewal date on it.
slides.body: Not three sticky notes and the inside of the van door.

slides.label: Luxury #4
slides.title: A Saturday where the 2 AM lockout is the only emergency.
slides.body: Not 'wait, when does our insurance renew?'
